notes.title: Progress Update - 10/2020
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Long time no see :) But we haven't been sleeping ;) I'd like to show you some of the latest progress on American Railroads!

A new locomotive has been implemented. It's a 2-8-0 Consolidation by Thomas, complete with tender and cab controls!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/50dd55e97d6ba4e8fdde7ff5330629577243aecc.jpg[/img]

Cab with interactive controls:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/61dbebedf36d0fe1777abfc29ebe98ad2527d010.jpg[/img]

The tender. We have put a lot of effort in a historically correct appearance on this one!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/9f468c4e571274b4aa73b3c0538ebc9df9ae4912.jpg[/img]

Headlight doors can be opened which allows you to light the burner
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/8eb2b33ba6c7a00ec251b904b8807e50038e4428.jpg[/img]

Sanding tower: refill your locomotive's sand domes here.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/48557000c154ee7114097f02da0ce6dfe8ea31fe.jpg[/img]

Water tower: The controls have been completely overhauled. You can now also swivel the spout left and right.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/7c85e67c6351b0745b7dc280693b836fe3d8dc7a.jpg[/img]

The mine, done by Kitsune, has been implemented. Pull the chutes and load your gondolas!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/646587694f582ef28ae5e917a1e23ebc5e22bf23.jpg[/img]

Iron ore.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/92a6b5fb547b6e3d26efb0d661c67ff0863e9e50.jpg[/img]

Trestles splines can now be dynamically placed just like different sets of track on the terrain.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/998e717b94f97cd01749519afa441bdad225de8a.jpg[/img]

Ideal to connect two hills:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/09135cb1e8c9a41f5bdd1db8b30100605a006a07.jpg[/img]

Also: A ton of coding, but that's not that interesting to show ;)

Next up: Saving and loading is going to be implemented. Also we have a bunch of new cars in stock, waiting to be added to the game ;)

We hope you enjoyed this small post!

If you haven't already joined, check out our official discord server down below for even more updates, screenshots and other cool stuff we will include!

[url=https://discord.gg/GjMSqzz]Official Discord Server[/url]

See you soon ;)

notes.title: Progress update: Heisler, mining, multiplayer
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

recently we have been working on some interesting stuff you might want to check out! 
The assistant modelers, Kitsune and Thomas have created some excellent new models that will be implemented in the coming updates!

Geared locomotive: Heisler
Based on the West Side Lumber Company No.3, this wood burning engine will soon handle some serious freight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/40df12d106a3c63db5495f3d71452584bb54b86f.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/e2cd348ce60bc16b6899a0dcbb5e99b7e917dc59.jpg[/img]

There will be 3 smokestack variants and an option for a wooden platform and storage boxes.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/9561d74de4f7f07e0a067ab38dca4c218ad25dcc.jpg[/img]

The V2 steam engine:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/c42273814841674600246079a735f61ab8c62118.jpg[/img]

As usually the cab comes with a lot of interactive levers and gauges for first person control
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/854787f11e8295eafcb044ff56ca6a46475ba169.jpg[/img]

The entire drive train will be fully animated
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/f09ac526f51823e84d1a6a85bf880c1b7c19db21.jpg[/img]

Mine: Just like the logging camp mines will produce ore that needs to be transported!
The ore will be loaded via chutes into the gondolas:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/2e33608af1c50a8da2b0bed27624b300b9d8b1bc.jpg[/img]

Mining gondolas: Perfect for transporting huge loads of ore from the mines:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/1fa0f78774719d14434b6fd4fb4e0ec5660e08db.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/972c172cc54b058b8597b7af6e98d4c54fab3be0.jpg[/img]

Also there is some progress regarding multiplayer:
The first primitive vehicle on a spline controlled track has been successfully tested in Unreal Multiplayer on a local server:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/a47e1a3eb785924c000fede6f064c229114ac4f3.jpg[/img]

We hope you enjoyed this small post!

If you haven't already joined, check out our official discord server down below for even more updates, screenshots and other cool stuff we will include!

[url=https://discord.gg/GjMSqzz]Official Discord Server[/url]

See you soon ;)

notes.title: American Railroads - UPDATE 1.5
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

update 1.5 is finally here!
It is quite a jump from the last version so here are the major changes:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/3e8ce749a3000a04300aadaf19f5c8556d54c345.jpg[/img]

[u]First person controls:[/u]
Grab some firewood, throw it in the boiler and explore Pine Valley in the first person perspective! Move around freely, steer and control your vehicles manually with fully animated bars, regulators and gauges

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/a486691bafc958602a7c6cc25d411f55a1bf17da.png[/img]

[u]Brand new cars, buildings, vehicles and tools: [/u]
Update 1.5 adds not only many new vehicles but also more realism: vehicles require regular maintenance, water and fuel in order to stay operational

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/e7cf213e0600be36ceed99ec297402c24848fcde.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/396def9c73df5549c9fbb750f9500f46084b1f20.jpg[/img]

[u]Build your own railroad:[/u]
Grab a pickaxe and start laying your own track! Invest in new equipment and place your utilities where they are needed

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/210fcb4d7ab24a552ca42b40ff47e811e81f7dab.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/d295cadd8484e19e41d1a18ce0dba0ed8eb0021a.jpg[/img]

[u]Customize your rolling stock: [/u]
Buy new equipment and choose your individual options, numbers, company and vehicle names!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/16a49a866099106de500c74a8b4d08915534e285.jpg[/img]

[u]New Roundhouse and facilities: [/u]
Buy and upgrade a engine house to service your vehicles with increased repair speed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/a534b680141a27a1e7cc6e461a14fdb6adbf8f8d.png[/img]

[u]Tutorial[/u]
The built in ingame tutorial pages will give you additional information

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/b675b8d604847e6d113958af268b180b14c51d1a.png[/img]

[u]Improved graphics and physics simulation[/u]
New lighting, texture and post processing effects like vignetting and depth of field add a more natural look. Also the physics implementation has been fundamentally overworked to improve stability and framerate

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/ec9488dc6e9c307901bd17db2f99c04ce12cb7a5.jpg[/img]

Have fun!

notes.title: Progress update 09/2019 - Climax Locomotive
notes.content:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

Finally the new steam event manager beta is working properly and i can show you the latest piece of machinery - the new Climax locomotive!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/0a3bfd34315fdef319bd6cbe5a29c8bdfc88b0cf.png[/img]

It's basically a two cylinder engine...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/8aa3c7d9f31d128cbd185b3c2ddbe85c1a877039.png[/img]

with a gearbox and bevel gears to drive the axles. Each axle will recieve the same amount of torque.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/43afc7497dadb646add49041972cb6389fd902d6.png[/img]

It will be available with a diamond- cylinder- or...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/c89d1225f27585ccb1eead01e093d3057dfa8af9.png[/img]

cabbage smokestack.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/9b56f3e5e84fb5ef06c91718e634bd7a30ae8bd3.png[/img]

Also there is enough space for water and firewood!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/9aa04850448a6d577fef738470f3bbc88054c798.png[/img]

It also features a backup light for pulling operations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32516809/dde02e5f90c1b9cbddcbb1852772022054f365a6.png[/img]

The perfect machine for big logging hauls!

notes.title: GIANT UPDATE 1.4
notes.content:
Dear community - Update 1.4 is out now!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/906e3a76ca4a9f25f8145bd710c600909e753c16.png[/img]

This is a rather big one.
The following changes have been done:

-Added animated sawmill Pine Valley Lumber Co. with log pond
It is now possible to transport timber logs to the sawmill which then can be dumped into a log pond. The logs are then automatically processed and your company will recieve a payment

-Added logging camp Silver Creek. It is now possible to order logs at the logging camp in Silver Creek. The logs have to be loaded onto the cars and transported to the sawmill
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/90f2962ec7cf067156701d42533cd78680f78b24.png[/img]

-Added realistic lighting. The entire lighting of the map has recieved an overhaul. Shadows and fog along with new textures give the map a more realistic feeling
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/3b8712efeb1d4adf971e2a2aabe13d101b11c030.png[/img]

-Added new rail textures

-Added day/night cycle: The game has now a constant day and night cycle.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/077fe9ecea601e1864628ac7618ad7791e5a5ab8.png[/img]

-Added new watertower. The watertower has been retextured. The pipe recieved two animated steel wires
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/699761ab222ec1d9e48a93932e6729248b33d665.png[/img]

-Added company-screen. By pressing "F2" the company screen appears giving you information about your spendings and earnings

-Added interactive freight car iron bars: The iron bars of the freight cars can now be toggled by pressing F4/F6

-Added new log models and textures

-Added river segment

-Added new sound effects

-Adjusted crane controls: logs which are hooked onto the crane can now be turned by tapping "Q" or "E"

-Adjusted depth of field

-Adjusted help screen

-Adjusted switch controls: switches can now only be changed by directly looking over the switch lever and pressing "left mouse button"

-Fixed derailing issues by adjusting physX contact parameters. Derailments are still possible e.g when going too fast over a rail joint

-Improved loading: The loading time has been reduced

-Changed track layout of the stations

Starting a new game is recommended!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32516809/cf0b1d6e39fcbd4b0b093afab7892d4f38737cf7.png[/img]


I hope you enjoy! And as always thanks for your support!

Best regards,
Stefan

after over one month it is time for another update. Update 1.2 will feature a fully steerable steam crane, which will allow you to load your trains with various goods. I have attached some screenshots to this post.

I plan to release this update by the end of next week. Also it will fix the bugs pointed out in the comment sections.

Thank you for your patience and your support so far!

Best regards,
Stefan

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1
notes.content:
Dear community!

Update 1.1 has just been released!

The following changes have been done:
- fixed contol keys: keys changed the volume instead of the locomotive levers or vice versa
- fixed coupling keys, requires your Numpad to be turned on!
- water tower nozzle now correctly moves back to its upward position
- info box description has been updated
- blur filter has been reduced
- set version to 1.1 in the main menu

BONUS:
- added whistle animation

Thank you for your constructive comments and discussions so far!
Let me know what you think!

Best regards,
Stefan
